request.prompt: Soft warm guzheng leads slow legato-like connected plucked phrases, delicate low bowed strings and a few distant gentle piano notes support. Unhurried, calm, lightly warm and reflective, gently easing the listener into the story. Comfortable breathing space within a continuous musical bed, no long silence or sparse empty drone. Slow pace, gentle transparent harmony with a trace of wistfulness, no ominous danger or horror pressure. No fast plucked runs, busy arpeggios, bouncy rhythm, playful comedy, festive folk dance, sugary romance, jazz, swing, triumphant fanfare, epic climax, pounding drums, bright chiming bells, EDM or rock guitar. Instrumental music only, no voice, choir, speech, wind, rain, insects, crackling, environmental ambience or sound effects. No extended intro, early outro or silent ending.  Follow the provided source phrase timing and recognizable melodic motif with the same gentle note spacing and restrained accompaniment throughout all 65 seconds. Small melodic and harmonic variations may unfold naturally while returning to the familiar phrase. No new rhythmic groove, bouncy plucking, cheerful comedy, dramatic crescendo, mournful tragedy, triumphant ending, long rests or abrupt early outro. Retain the slow gently plucked guzheng lead and very soft low bowed strings, no rapid runs, fast ostinato or comic sparkle.
